zh-Hant.title: 1.4.3 有什麼新功能
highlights: 新版本推出時會在 App 內提醒你更新。
升級後首次開啟會顯示這個「新功能」說明。

en.title: What's new in 1.4.3
highlights: The app now reminds you in-app when a new version is available.
After upgrading, this "What's new" summary appears on first launch.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.0 有什麼新功能
highlights: 跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.0
highlights: Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.1 有什麼新功能（沿用 v2.0.0 內容）
highlights: 因為 Play Store 跳過 v2.0.0，故此版本新內容沿用 v2.0.0 內容。
跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.1
highlights: Due to Play Store skipping v2.0.0, the new features in this version are the same as v2.0.0.
Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.2 新功能
highlights: 課表時間修正
修正 TigerSync 相關詞匯
修正 Widget 顯示成其他版面或錯誤畫面的問題
翻譯優化
行事曆顯示優化

en.title: What's new in 2.0.2
highlights: Class table time correction
Fix TigerSync related terms
Fix the problem of Widget displaying other layouts or error screens
Translation optimization
Calendar display optimization

zh-Hant.title: 2.1.0 新功能
highlights: TigerSync 設定頁重新整理
通知設定跨裝置同步
修正 Moodle 登入過期時不會顯示的通知
即時更新提前時間與 iOS 版一致
推播依 App 介面語言顯示

en.title: What's new in 2.1.0
highlights: TigerSync settings page reorganized
Notification settings sync across devices
Fix the notification that never appeared when the Moodle login expired
Live Updates lead time now matches the iOS version
Push notifications follow the app's interface language

zh-Hant.title: 2.2.0 新功能
highlights: 修正三星 NowBar、小米系列超級島以及其他品牌手機的即時更新顯示問題
修正了多部門合開課程無法連接 Moodle 的問題
修正了新增課程不會即時顯示的問題
新增校園信箱功能
設定中可以查看 App 使用的開源授權
設定中的「關於」頁面重新整理，相關連結更好找
課表與課程詳情顯示更多課程資訊
公告頁面的滑動與搜尋操作優化

en.title: What's new in 2.2.0
highlights: Fix Live Updates display on Samsung NowBar, Xiaomi series HyperIsland and other devices
Fix the issue of courses co-taught by multiple departments cannot connect to Moodle
Fix the issue of newly added courses do not display immediately
Added campus email feature
View the open-source licences the app uses in Settings
About page in settings reorganized, making links easier to find
Class table and course details show more course information
Improved scrolling and search on the bulletins page

items.title: 匯出課表圖片
items.body: 可將課表存成圖片或分享。

items.title: 通知分類堆疊
items.body: 課程、作業、信件與其他通知分開堆疊。

items.title: 信箱體驗優化
items.body: 信箱介面與操作更順手。

items.title: 修正通知類別語言
items.body: 通知類別名稱會跟隨 App 語言（包含 HyperOS）。

items.title: 優化背景同步
items.body: 背景同步更穩定。

items.title: 介面與操作優化
items.body: 頁面切換與返回手勢更流暢，也不再重複詢問通知權限。

items.title: Export your class table
items.body: Save or share it as an image.

items.title: Notifications stack by kind
items.body: Classes, homework, mail and others stack separately.

items.title: A better mail experience
items.body: School Mail is smoother to use.

items.title: Notification names fixed
items.body: Notification categories follow the app's language, HyperOS included.

items.title: Better background sync
items.body: Background sync is more reliable.

items.title: Optimized UI/UX
items.body: Smoother page transitions and back swipes, and no more repeated notification prompts.

items.title: 通知、即時更新與動態島優化
items.body: 針對 Pixel 即時更新、vivo 原子島、HONOR Magic Capsule、OPPO 流體雲、三星 Now Bar 與小米系列（含 Redmi、POCO）超級島逐一調校。

items.title: 修正「更多」頁文字溢出
items.body: 放大字型或顯示大小時，卡片上的功能名稱不再被截斷。

items.title: 修正新功能說明頁異常
items.body: 往上滑動後頁面不再自己彈跳，橫向或分割畫面時也不會被狀態列擋住。

items.title: Better notifications, Live Updates and Dynamic Island
items.body: Tuned one by one for Pixel's Live Updates, vivo's Origin Island, HONOR's Magic Capsule, OPPO's Live Alerts, Samsung's Now Bar and HyperIsland on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO.

items.title: More tab text fixed
items.body: Feature names on the cards no longer get cut off at larger font or display sizes.

items.title: What's new page fixed
items.body: It no longer bounces after a swipe up, and stays clear of the status bar in landscape or split screen.

items.title: Moodle 新功能
items.body: 在 App 裡就能查看課程公告、成績、課堂成員、課程教材與作業詳細資料。

items.title: 課表分享
items.body: 用 QR code 或連結分享課表，對方用 TigerDuck 或任何掃描器都能打開。

items.title: 校園信箱功能增強
items.body: 通知可以依來源關閉，例如臺科公告欄與 Moodle 繳交通知，也能設定勿擾時段。

items.title: 更多主題顏色
items.body: 新增漸層色，也可以自訂顏色。

items.title: 空教室查看
items.body: 介面更好懂，還會自動推薦離你最近的空教室。

items.title: TigerSync 與伺服器同步優化
items.body: 與 TigerSync 及其他伺服器的同步更穩定。

items.title: TLS pin 改從 TigerSync 取得
items.body: 學校網站更換憑證時，不必等 App 更新就能繼續安全連線。

items.title: 自訂介面與文字大小
items.body: App 與小工具的介面和文字大小都能自己調整。

items.title: 介面顯示優化
items.body: 許多畫面的排版與動畫更順暢。

items.title: More from Moodle
items.body: See course announcements, grades, classmates, course materials and assignment details right in the app.

items.title: Share your class table
items.body: Share it as a QR code or a link. It opens in TigerDuck or in any QR scanner.

items.title: School Mail, upgraded
items.body: Turn notifications off by source, such as the NTUST bulletin board and Moodle submission notices, and set quiet hours.

items.title: More theme colors
items.body: Gradients, plus colors of your own.

items.title: Empty classrooms
items.body: A clearer layout that suggests the nearest free room.

items.title: Better syncing
items.body: Syncing with TigerSync and the other servers is more reliable.

items.title: TLS pins from TigerSync
items.body: When a school site changes its certificate, secure connections keep working without waiting for an app update.

items.title: Choose your sizes
items.body: Set the size of the app's and widgets' layout and text.

items.title: Display improvements
items.body: Smoother layouts and animations across the app.
